description: Look up TikTok sounds by URL/ID or search by keyword. Returns sound metadata, artist and DSP details, plus the videos using each sound.

includeErrorRows.description: Emit a row with rowType='error' when an input cannot be read, instead of only logging it. Off by default.
includeErrorRows.title: Include Error Rows

includeMusicMetadata.description: Emit a metadata row per sound with title, creator/artist, duration, covers, DSP IDs, tags and video count.
includeMusicMetadata.title: Include Sound Metadata

includePosts.description: Emit one row per video that uses the sound, with author, caption, hashtags, mentions, POI, effects, slideshow images and engagement counts.
includePosts.title: Include Videos Using The Sound

maxPostsPerSound.description: Videos to collect per sound (0-500). Set 0 for sound metadata only. TikTok can cap the public feed per run, so fewer rows may be returned and the run status reports any shortfall.
maxPostsPerSound.title: Max Videos Per Sound

maxSoundsPerQuery.description: (mode=searchSounds) Keep at most this many sounds per keyword. TikTok returns a maximum of 30.
maxSoundsPerQuery.title: Max Sounds Per Query

minLikeCount.description: Drop videos below this like count. 0 keeps everything. Videos without a like count are kept only when this is 0.
minLikeCount.title: Minimum Like Count

minPlayCount.description: Drop videos below this play count. 0 keeps everything. Videos without a play count are kept only when this is 0.
minPlayCount.title: Minimum Play Count

mode.description: Choose how to find sounds: by sound URL/ID, or by keyword search.
enumTitles: Look up sounds by URL or ID
mode.title: Mode

musicIds.description: (mode=bySound) Numeric TikTok sound IDs, 15-20 digits, as an alternative to full URLs.
musicIds.title: Sound IDs

publishedWithin.description: Keep only videos published inside this window. Applied after collection, to video rows.
publishedWithin.title: Published Within

searchQueries.description: (mode=searchSounds) Keywords to search in TikTok's sound catalogue, e.g. lofi, phonk, afrobeats. Each query returns up to 30 sounds; duplicates are removed across queries.
searchQueries.title: Sound Search Queries

uniqueCreatorsOnly.description: Keep only the highest-play video per author across the run. Useful for audience and creator discovery.
uniqueCreatorsOnly.title: One Video Per Creator

title: TikTok Sound & Music Scraper Input
